script.problem: It uses a reaction phrase. The code shows reactions; the explanation never does.

terra.problem: Egypt is not mentioned only in connection with past striking. Verse 26 also recalls the LORD raising His staff over the sea in Egypt.
Pharaoh's identification as Egypt's king is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Nebuchadnezzar's identification as a king of Babylon needs a reference. Coffee also breaks the food rule.
Papa comments on his own delivery by announcing that he will not joke and will let the verse sit.
Papa comments on his own delivery by saying he will keep it simple and plain.
The hat comparison does not make sense: the yoke breaks because the neck is too large, so it is unclear why Papa would want a hat that fits that way.
Calling Nob the end of the line for the army goes beyond the text, which says only that they halt there.
The passage does not say Jerusalem was the intended destination of the whole march.
The geographical fact about Samaria is from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Damascus's identification as the capital of Aram needs a reference. Saying 'Wrong map' also uses 'wrong' about the baker's answer.
The verse does not say the branches are lopped first and the tall trees cut down afterward.
The joke that the tall ones are 'in for a big day' makes light of the terrifying judgment pictured in the passage.
The passage says Lebanon will fall; it does not say that nothing stands firm before the Mighty One.
The fact that Lebanon was known for tall cedars comes from outside the passage and needs a reference.
The passage says Lebanon will fall before the Mighty One, but does not say the Mighty One is standing.
